about: Recorded U3 route matrix (175 live dry runs on 2026-10-23; swaps, bridges and cross-network swaps). Each alternative is an independently quoted route: out/min in base units of the requested output, gas and extra costs in USD, provider seconds. 'supported' marks routes Kletia can execute after P3-M3 (Across ETH added). Earn and departure cases are not route choices and are left out. Two-hop DEX routes via USDT/USDT0 and cbBTC are supported since P3-M1 (RC4).
